observations.assessment: Bilateral two contacts/half-cycle are stated topology. Fixed stationary0.05 and downed minimum0.8 are checked speed constants, explicitly distinct from configurable playback hysteresis; they remain policy/config ownership obligations under crate guide, not automatically mathematical identities. LocomotionProfile public Serde fields include NonnegativeSpeed reference and NonnegativeLength step; LandingProfile recovery AnimationElapsed permits zero. Typed leaves do not enforce profile aggregate positivity/order.

animation_local_velocity uses raised local velocity when guard raised/moving else authoritative local velocity. animation_speed checks completed horizontal norm before typed admission and applies downed minimum0.8 only when turning. Profile accessors each read runtime_animation_config and project gait config; actual same server snapshot/coherence remains needed, names alone no guarantee.

Body prone/supine selects own profile, raised nonsprint overrides step length, ordinary profile interpolates walk/run using run-minus-walk reference divisor. Typed checked lerp/scaled heights precede return. ordinary_step_distance uses fixed0.9m stationary intercept then authored walk/run references; equal/zero profile config needs canonical validation before witness. Existing profile admission contract covers zero-permitting retained references and separate pair order; tuning intercept retains separate ownership question.

gait_cycle_phase_delta computes speed*elapsed divided by max(step,0.01)*2 then checked CycleDelta;0.01m floor is fixed physical policy, two steps structural. Huge denominator multiplication alone is not proof of intended-result failure; actual valid profile/current bounds needed. gait_support_weights returns both1 for RaisedGuard, otherwise assumes phase periodic neighborhood with min(abs(phase-contact),1-delta) and support radius*0.45 smoothstep. CyclePhase itself unwrapped, so actual caller wrapping prerequisite essential before supported negative-distance/all-support witness. Degenerate smoothstep edges have explicit step policy.

Exact weakening handoff: landing_profile sets recovery_seconds=config.recovery_seconds.elapsed(); gait_profile sets reference_speed=config.reference_speed_metres_per_second.nonnegative() and positive step into nonnegative. Retained public serde profile loses configured positive role at conversion. Direct support for ADLER-L11-LOCOMOTION-PROFILE-ADMISSION; actual source config types/validator, all consumers/current and exact aliases still required.
